title: Strict etale exceptional adjoint interfaces
statement: For a compactification $c$ and a strict etale compact-support system $S$ [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces], define the strict exceptional-adjoint interface to consist of an additive exact linear right adjoint to the system compact-support functor, its finite-level adjunctions, and evaluation isomorphisms fixed by the adjunction-mate equation. Include the universal derived coefficient-change maps, their open and proper mate normalizations, quotient identity and composition equations, the actual transition equation, a uniform lower bound, and preservation of bounded-below normalized systems. The universal derived image and normalization interfaces are those of [def-pur-coefficient-system-image-data].
